by SetsuYomi

Summary

When the Kremnoan 5 decided to invite their Crown Prince to meet up while visiting Okhema not long after being resurrected post true Era Nova, they never thought that they'd be met with a peculiar sight:

Mydeimos, being heavily pregnant, waddling along with his huge puppy of a husband, the famed Deliverer of Okhema.

(Is it time for them to plan for baby shower? They wonder...)

Notes

Okay, so.
It's been /years/ since the last time I posted here (i think), so my writing skill might be rusty af. Idc tho i just want to see pregdei and fussy phai tending him 24/7 with everyone in Ampho being the (mostly)unwilling witnesses.

Starting from their closest companions and family of course hehe (๑´ㅂ`๑)

This is unbetaed and purely self indulgent, enjoy!!!

See the end of the work for more notes

chapters.title: Witness, the Lily blooms under Kephale's light
chapters.html:
A year after the end of Irontomb, the situation in Amphoreus is starting to stabilize. With the planet gradually turning into reality, little by little their world unfurl, bringing back nations and villages from dusts, along with it, people they thought long lost gradually come back from their 'death'.

And that, includes Mydeimos' brothers in arms. With them slowly learning everything post the trur Era Nova, they too, wish to meet their youngest comrade, after having manifested one by one in Castrum Kremnos for a while.

Now, if only Mydei's fussy husband would stop fluttering around him like a nervous nymph, he'll be very grateful. Listlessly checking his complexion, his hair and clothes, to strapping his sandals without being asked, then asking Mydei if he's 'sure to go out today, have you eaten enough, do you need anything' that borders between endearing to irritating after 10 minutes. Five months into his pregnancy with twins and he treats Mydei like he's immobilized, tsk.

"Phainon."

Like a startled oryx, his husband freezes in front of him. "Yes, dear?"

"Quit it, we've stalled too long as it is, they must be waiting for us at the meeting place. It's just a short walk and taking a walk is recommended by the midwives after all, we'll be fine."

'We'

At the reminder that Mydeimos is currently with their children, Phainon melts a little. He knows he's been worrying a lot, but it's Mydei's first pregnancy in their first ever chance of starting a family now that peace is attained. It couldn't be helped that Phainon wants to spoil his wife whenever and wherever. Though he does admit that he tends to hover and a bit overprotective. Sue him for wanting to tend to Mydei and worship the very ground he walks, he huffs to himself.

Seeing his husband busy with his internal monologue, Mydei sighs softly, "Khaslana, snap out of it. Let's go, they'd be wondering where I am if we arrives later than this."

"Ahaha.. Alright, alright. I'm sorry, love." Chuckling apologetically, Phainon takes his wife's hand and start walking. Side by side they depart from their house towards the locations where Mydei's friends are.

ꕤ𓏸𓈒𓂃ʚ💙ɞ・☀️🍷・ ʚ❤️ɞ 𓂃𓈒𓏸ꕤ

Sitting on a large table in the garden near Kremnoan settlement in Okhema, five men sit idly while waiting for their Prince to arrive. It's been 15 minutes from their scheduled time, none will admit it but they're starting to get worried. Just when Leonnius about to open his mouth, he snaps it shut once he sees something from the gate, making a gesture for the others to follow his line of sight.

From a far, two distinctive people enter the compound. One tall, broad shouldered, with white hair and smile so blinding it rivaled the Kephale's light, chattering animatedly. While the other one is clearly their Prince with his lion mane hair braided in one long tail (longer than they ever remembered) and his familiar red tattoos, standing a bit shorter than the supposed Hero of Amphoreus (for which they've been informed by a trusted sourcecoughKrateroscough as Mydeimos' husband and the current Worldbearer Titan).

They all could see the way Mydeimos walks slowly, wearing a cream colored maternity dress with golden accent (a work of art from the renowned Goldweaver for sure) that should look weird on any other man as big as him, but it makes him look angelic instead, beyond delicate with the way the fabric hugs his pregnant belly in a soft flowy motions. Especially with the way he waddles along with his big puppy of a husband dutifully walking besides him, a hand hovering discreetly behind his back, talking things a mile in a minute.

When the Kremnoan 5 proposed a meet up with their crown prince after the true Era Nova, this scene is far from what they could imagine, even in their wildest dreams. But here they are, dumbfoundedly gaping while watching their youngest member, heavily pregnant, with his hero of a husband that looks like a towering samoyed, approaching their location steadily.

Phainon looks a second away from whisking their prince away with every glace, but the man admirably hold back, they respect him for that. Mydei does too, by the way he smiles knowingly at his husband.

Once they're near, everyone welcomes the couple to the bench they occupied. The talk started awkwardly at first, it's not everyday you woke up after era nova with the knowledge that you've lived in cycles before, but they were a tight knit group, so the conversation smoothen up on its own after some time. They talk about everything and nothing, mainly the comfortable topics such as Castrum Kremnos and Mydeimos' daily life as a Chrysos Heir in the true Era Nova.

The Deliverer sits idly, chiming in once in a while when asked, but not butting in when not needed. He stays respectful in their circle, just content in watching Mydei reunites with his newly resurrected-old friends.

After a few hours though, everyone can see how the Crown Prince is starting to nod off, struggling to keep his eyes open, and slowly leaning back towards his husband's side. He tries to keep engaging their conversation, but it seems like the feeling of drowsiness is the clear winner for this round.

Phainon chuckles softly once Mydei completely fall asleep on his shoulder, letting his pregnant wife settle comfortably against him. It's about the usual time Mydei would take a nap since his pregnancy, so after all this excitement, it's not unexpected that he'd get tired easily today.

Adjusting his hold on Mydei, Phainon looks at them with a smile, "Thank you, gentlemen, for the amazing time. I guess it's our time to bid you goodbye, as our bright star has decided to take his nap. Mydei has been ecstatic about this, I think the excitement has worn him out faster than he usually feels, so on his behalf, I apologize and thank you, once again, for your company. He misses all of you dearly, I'm sure he would like to arrange another meet up with you in the near future. For now, we shall bade our farewell. See you tomorrow!"

The five of them wishes him gratitude and goodbyes in return with contentment and various enthusiasm. Watching the man expertly puts an arm under Mydeimos' lower back and tighs in one hand, then slipping off his wife's sandals with another. All of them mesmerized with the smooth way he maneuvered Mydeimos' body without waking him up in the slightest and relieving the man's swollen feet from its prison.

He waits until Mydei settled fully on his chest, tucking Mydei's head under his chin, and only then he steadily walks back with his precious treasure in a one hand bridal carry, back to their abode. The true picture of besotted man, dutifully carrying his pregnant wife like he weighs nothing.

ꕤ𓏸𓈒𓂃ʚ💙ɞ・☀️🍷・ ʚ❤️ɞ 𓂃𓈒𓏸ꕤ
